projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: Producer Portal deployed to Production and validated with 11 users on 10/22. Premera planning big-bang rollout to 2,500+ producers on October 22.
riskDescription.condition: Issues may be encountered during mass producer onboarding at scale, requiring rollback and remediation.
riskDescription.consequence: Rollback would disrupt 2,500+ producers, damage client trust, delay business value realization, and require unplanned remediation effort.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement phased rollout with pilot cohorts of 100-250 producers weekly, validating performance and user experience before full deployment.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon critical defect affecting 10% of users, activate rollback procedure within 2 hours and escalate to project board immediately.
risks.reasoning: ALT explicit risk with escalation trigger and WATCHLIST status; limited pre-rollout validation scale (11 users vs. 2,500+) and big-bang strategy amplify likelihood.

riskDescription.context: Project has absorbed 14 scope changes equivalent to 0.75-1 sprint of additional effort. EMS R857 is open and Identified with mitigation assessed but not implemented.
riskDescription.condition: Further scope additions may occur without corresponding timeline or resource adjustments.
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery timelines could slip, team capacity could be strained, and quality may be compromised to meet fixed deadlines.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal change control board with client, requiring impact assessment and approval for all scope changes before acceptance.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When scope changes exceed 1 sprint effort, rebaseline timeline and communicate revised delivery dates to stakeholders within 48 hours.
risks.reasoning: Carried forward from open EMS risk R857 (opened 2026-06-29); historical pattern of 14 changes and assessed-but-not-implemented mitigation support likelihood.

riskDescription.context: Citrix slowness and frequent disconnection are impacting delivery, acknowledged in EMS Go-Green Plan. Ticket to be raised with Premera.
riskDescription.condition: Infrastructure performance issues may persist or worsen if Premera does not resolve Citrix issues promptly.
riskDescription.consequence: Development and support team productivity could decline, delaying defect resolution and post-rollout support during critical Hypercare period.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Raise priority ticket with Premera IT, implement Citrix workaround keeping Windows app open, and monitor connectivity daily during Hypercare.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Citrix issues persist beyond 5 business days, provide VDI access to critical team members and reprioritize non-dependent tasks.
risks.reasoning: EMS Go-Green Plan explicit item; mitigation planned but not started, external dependency on Premera, timing critical during Hypercare.

riskDescription.context: Azure 4xx/5xx alerts generating false-positives due to invalid email-format failures. Retry logic update in progress per EMS Go-Green Plan.
riskDescription.condition: Until retry logic is deployed and validated in Production, genuine production failures may be masked by false-positives, or alerts may remain disabled.
riskDescription.consequence: Critical production issues during or after the 2,500+ producer rollout could go undetected, delaying incident response and impacting user experience.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Deploy retry logic update to Production by week-end, validate alert accuracy, and re-enable Azure 4xx/5xx monitoring under Hypercare observation.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should genuine production failures be detected after alert re-enablement, activate manual log review every 4 hours and notify on-call team.
risks.reasoning: EMS Go-Green Plan; deployment to Production pending, Hypercare monitoring planned, timing coincides with high-risk mass rollout.

riskDescription.context: End-to-end OKTA registration process validated with only 11 users on 10/22. Big-bang rollout to 2,500+ producers planned immediately after. EMS R856 (resolved) noted performance/NFR issues visible only after integration.
riskDescription.condition: Performance, scalability, or edge-case issues may surface only at scale, as NFR and load testing under realistic production conditions were limited.
riskDescription.consequence: System performance degradation, user experience issues, or functional defects could emerge during rollout, requiring emergency fixes or rollback.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct production load testing with 500 concurrent users, monitor API response times and database performance daily during rollout week.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once response time exceeds 3 seconds or error rate reaches 5%, throttle user access and deploy performance patches within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: ALT: 11-user validation vs. 2,500+ rollout scale gap; EMS R856 (resolved 2026-06-29) context supports concern; big-bang strategy limits incremental validation.

riskDescription.context: Premera is responsible for sending registration emails to 2,500+ producers on October 22. This is a client-controlled dependency per ALT.
riskDescription.condition: Premera may delay or modify the email campaign timing or scope, or email delivery issues (spam filters, incorrect distribution lists) may occur.
riskDescription.consequence: Producer onboarding could be delayed, adoption targets missed, or incomplete rollout could create support and communication challenges.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Validate email distribution list with Premera weekly, confirm spam filter whitelisting, and establish backup communication channel via client portal.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If email delivery fails for more than 10% of recipients, coordinate with Premera to resend within 48 hours and provide direct registration links via support channel.
risks.reasoning: ALT explicit client dependency; external control, big-bang approach amplifies impact of any delay or issue.
